units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:59">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵈ</cite> <he>הנוֹפֵח כלי זכוכית</he> he who shapes glass vessels by blowing (on the Sabbath); Bab.
<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 1:6">Makhsh. I, 6</cite> <he>הנופח בעדשים וכ׳</he> he who breathes at lentils to ascertain their quality.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:2">Tosef. Sabb. XV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:2">XVI</cite>), 2 <he>נופח בחוטמו וכ׳</he> you blow into its nostrils and put the teat into its mouth; <cite ref="Shabbat 128b">Sabb. 128ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. XVIII, end, 16ᶜ <he>מביא יין ונופח וכ׳</he> you take wine and squirt it &c.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 60b:3">B. Mets. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>אין נוֹפְחִין בקרביים</he> it is not permitted to blow up entrails (for sale, to give them a delusive appearance); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be blown up, to swell. Tanḥ. K’dosh. 8 נָפְחוּ פניו his face was swollen. Ib. עיניו נְפוּחוֹת his eyes swollen.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 4:5">Maasr. IV, 5</cite> <he>מְנַפֵּיחַ</he> … <he>ואם ני׳ וכ׳</he> Y. ed. (Bab. ed. <he>מנפח … נפח</he>; Ms. M. <he>מנפיח</he>; Mish. ed. <he>מנפה … נפה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 7) he may blow out (the chaff of the wheat-ears) from hand to hand and eat, but if he blows and puts the grain in his lap, he is bound (to pay tithes); <cite ref="Beitzah 13b:10">Bets. 13ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 19b">Ber. 19ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Niddah 57a">Nidd. 57ᵃ</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="Q01909"><he>פְּרַס</he></cite>; a. fr.—[Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵇ top <he>המנפח</he>, read <he>המכפח</he>, v. <cite ref="S01725"><he>קָפַח</he></cite>.]

<cite ref="Tractate Semachot 8:11">Treat. S’maḥ. ch. VIII</cite> <he>מוטב … אש שנוּפְּחָה ולא אש שלא נופחה וכ׳</he> it is better that a fire consume me which has been blown (by man), than a fire that has not been fanned (Gehenna; <cite ref="Job 20:26">Job XX, 26</cite>).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:4">Num. R. s. 7</cite> <he>תִּנָּפֵחַ כרסי וכ׳</he> my belly may swell and burst.
